title: Try the neovim plugin with the real viewer inside decade
body: The plugin in editors/nvim and acre-gui --stdio landed in 934e4ef, tested in headless neovim against a stand-in viewer only. A run with the real viewer from neovim inside decade put the viewer's window in another workspace, which decade-1919e9 is to settle. Once that lands, run :AcreView from neovim in a decade pane on figures/key-schemes.acre and check four things: where the window goes, rendering as you type, a click on the render moving neovim's cursor, and an error showing as a diagnostic. Open a window outside scratch_open only after Jack says to.
